story: Martinez was the last rider caught from an early breakaway of four as the race entered a hilly finale. On the final climb, Pogačar launched an attack that was countered by Vingegaard. The group of favorites regrouped, and in the uphill sprint, Pogačar powered to victory, marking the 100th win of his career.
